tasks.goal: You have a new bookcase in the hall with four shelves. Get it into the app.

lostMoments.words: The Library draws all three bookcases and offers nothing anywhere, top or bottom, that adds a fourth. The only thing left is the round icon in the top corner, which is still drawn as a person's head and shoulders and reads as an account or profile. The harness tells me it is called 'Your fixtures'; the picture does not, and 'fixtures' is not a word I would use about my own bookcases anyway.

I have typed Hall into 'What you call it' and there is no button belonging to that field, or to 'What it is' below it. The only Save on the screen sits inside a different card headed 'Nothing yet: it has no areas on it' above a line reading 'What it will be called'. I cannot tell whether pressing it saves the name I typed or makes a shelf, and the heading at the top still says Bookcase 5.
